purpose: Define fail-closed point-in-time eligibility rules for historical central-bank market-pricing data used by GLOBAL MACRO FX QUANT. This contract does not authorize production publication and does not modify OIS_DATA, NATIVE_CB_DATA, engine logic, or UI runtime.

scope.historical_goal: Reconstruct only information that was reproducibly available from the authorized source by the decision timestamp.

temporal_eligibility.principle: A market-pricing observation may influence a historical decision only after the source-defined settlement/publication is available.
temporal_eligibility.same_day_use: Forbidden unless the official source provides a verified publication timestamp that is earlier than the historical decision timestamp.
temporal_eligibility.unknown_publication_time: Use only from the next decision point after the observation date.
temporal_eligibility.t_minus_1: Must be the previous complete official session on the same authorized basis.
temporal_eligibility.weekly_reference: Must follow the source-specific certified rule; calendar approximations are forbidden unless explicitly part of the source contract.
temporal_eligibility.contract_rolls: 3M/6M/12M mappings must be deterministic and reproducible for each historical as-of date; silent contract remapping is forbidden.

AUD.method: Direct official settlement prices, 100 minus rate, no interpolation
AUD.weekly_reference_rule: Fifth prior complete official ASX trading session (T-5)

CAD.method: Direct official settlement prices, 100 minus compounded CORRA, no interpolation
CAD.weekly_reference_rule: Complete official MX session nearest to as_of minus 7 calendar days; ties prefer on/before target

GBP.instrument: Estimated sterling instantaneous OIS forward curve based on SONIA
GBP.method: Exact official 3M/6M/12M forward-curve columns, no interpolation

JPY.method: Direct official settlement prices, 100 minus compounded TONA, no interpolation
JPY.weekly_reference_rule: Nearest complete official TFX session on or before as_of minus 5 calendar days

USD.blocker: Homogeneous official T-5 settlement history is unavailable to the current automated environment; CME archive access is blocked/Datamine-routed.

EUR.blocker: Free official historical files do not expose required settlement prices on a reproducible homogeneous basis.

CHF.blocker: Public metadata does not provide reproducible daily historical settlement prices; official EOD history is not exposed as a free public series.

NZD.authority: Reserve Bank of New Zealand / NZD OIS market
NZD.instrument: NZD OIS linked to OCR expectations
NZD.blocker: Public RBNZ B2 does not publish the required OIS curve; standard swap series are not a clean OCR/OIS substitute.

governance: Better WITHHELD than inferred historical certainty. A source moves from WITHHELD to certifiable only after homogeneous official historical observations and temporal eligibility can be reproduced without look-ahead.
